name: Blurry (Sticky) Finger
summary: Image-plane pointing for optical see-through AR that relies on proprioception: the out-of-focus fingertip covers the distant target.
howItWorks: The user holds up a finger so that, from the eye's view, it overlaps the distant object; the finger is blurry because the eyes focus on the target, yet still selects it.
